newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sept palm oil output seen up six pct - Ivan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sept palm oil output seen up six pct - Ivan.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in September was estimated to have risen by six percent to 860,000 tonnes over August, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Monday.
Wong estimated end-Sept palm oil stocks at 910,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 800,893 tonnes at end-August.
He said palm oil exports in September were projected to be 655,000 tonnes from PORLA's 638,601 tonnes.
"Latest partial data for first-half September indicated a slowdown in the seasonal production in both the Peninsular and in East Malaysia," Wong said in his release today.
"The performance of several major producers in Peninsular Malaysia ranged from down two to up five percent," he said.

Wong said palm oil exports remain good this month and should be higher than PORLA's preliminary August figure. He added Indonesia took 20,000 tonnes RBD palm olein during the September 1-20 against nothing in August.
